sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row #3 and Internal Quality Checks row #3 (instruction_is_spelled_right_and_uncontaminated; internal annotation says 'stray paths' instead of 'other machines' paths', no extra annotation columns)
evidence: Read the full brief (instruction.md, 9 lines) and all three note files (90 lines total); frozen hashes match the manifest and the live projects/kittle-matter-chat copies (diff -q identical). Grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|<placeholder>|tbd|lorem|/home/|C:|F:|Users\|kittle-worktree|.qc|claude|judge|rubric|score found nothing except two in-world uses of the word 'placeholder' (conversations.md:9 'leaves the same placeholder as one a timer removed'; walls-and-retention.md:35 'appears only as a placeholder'), which are product requirements, not template residue. The template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt' line is fully replaced. All files are pure ASCII, LF, no BOM, no doubled spaces or doubled words, no trailing whitespace. Manual proofreading found no spelling errors (consistent British register: 'mustn't', 'trying-out', 'lengthening'). Contradiction scan: one clock value (integration.md:7 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z = seed clock); one seed path (/assets/seed_data.json in instruction.md:5 and integration.md:5, matching Dockerfile COPY assets/ /assets/); one DB path (/app/app.db + DB_PATH in instruction.md:5 and integration.md:3); one account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11, exactly matching seed accounts names/roles); timer options off/1/7/30 match seed timer_options_days [null,1,7,30]; 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12' matches seed M-12 walled ['dev@kittle.test']; /instructions and /app paths match the Dockerfile. Apparent tensions checked and resolved: Escape discards an open edit (conversations.md:29) vs stale-save keeps typed text (conversations.md:9) are different situations; deleted-with-replies placeholder is described identically in conversations.md:9 and walls-and-retention.md:25,35; hold keeps versions (walls:29) vs deletion removes versions (walls:25) are complementary. No author asides, no grader vocabulary, no other machines' paths. Adversarial angle: no contaminated text exists that could mislead a conforming build into failing or let a broken build exploit a contradiction. Seed message bodies are in-world (the HTML in K-16 is an intended markup-escaping fixture backing conversations.md:13). This row is source-only; no runtime evidence is required.
